title: Terms and Conditions
html:
General terms and conditions and customer information

Terms and Conditions

  • Basic provisions
The following terms and conditions apply to all contracts that you, as a supplier (ASSCA GmbH), have concluded with us via the website www.astano.de, unless the parties have agreed otherwise in writing. Deviating or conflicting terms and conditions apply only with our express consent.

We offer our goods for sale only to natural or legal persons or legally capable partnerships who, when concluding a legal transaction, are acting in the course of their commercial or independent professional activity (entrepreneurs). The conclusion of a sales contract with consumers is excluded.

  • Conclusion of contract
The subject of this contract is the sale of products. The most important characteristics of the goods are listed in the respective offer.

By publishing the product in question on our website, we are making you a binding offer to conclude a contract via the online shopping cart system under the conditions specified in the item description.

The contract is concluded via the online shopping cart system as follows:

The items you intend to purchase are placed in your shopping cart. You can access your shopping cart via the corresponding button in the navigation bar and make changes there at any time.

After clicking the "Checkout" or "Continue to Order" button (or a similar label) and entering your personal data as well as the payment and shipping conditions, the order details will finally be displayed to you as an order overview.

If you used an instant payment system (e.g., PayPal/PayPal Express, Amazon Payments, Sofort) for payment processing, you will either be redirected to our online shop from the order overview page or to the payment provider's website. If you are redirected to the payment provider, please select your preferred system and enter your details. You will then be returned to the order overview page in our online shop.

Before submitting your order, you can review all the data again, change it (which is also possible via the "back" function of your internet browser) or cancel the purchase transaction.

By clicking the corresponding button to submit the order, you declare your acceptance of the order in a legally binding manner, thereby concluding the contract.

  • Furthermore, you can submit a binding offer (an order) by telephone, email, fax or post.
The offer is accepted (and the contract is therefore concluded) if the telephone order is confirmed immediately or at the latest within 5 days by a written confirmation (e.g. by e-mail) confirming the execution of the order or the delivery of the goods (order confirmation).

Should you not receive a corresponding notification within this period, you are no longer bound by your order. Any payments already made will be refunded to you immediately in this case.

  • We will provide you with a customized quote upon request, which we will send to you in paper form and which will be binding for us for 5 days. You can accept the quote by providing written confirmation.
  • Order processing and the transmission of all information necessary for concluding the contract are partially automated and carried out via email. Therefore, you must ensure that the email address you have registered with us is correct and that you can receive emails. In particular, you must check whether emails are being blocked by a spam filter.
  • Individually designed products
Please use our online ordering system to send us the information, texts, or files necessary for the individual customization of your desired products. Alternatively, you can also send them to us by email. In this case, please send us the information promptly after concluding the contract. Please note any specifications from the supplier regarding file formats.

You are obligated to ensure that you do not transmit any data whose content infringes the rights of third parties (in particular copyrights, name rights, and trademark rights) or violates applicable law. You expressly indemnify us against all related claims by third parties. This also applies to the costs of any legal representation that may be necessary.

We do not check the transmitted data for textual accuracy. Therefore, we accept no liability for errors.

If such a provision is included in the product description, we will send you a proof for review, which you should check immediately. If you approve the draft, please confirm its approval for production by countersigning it in writing (e.g., by email).

Tasks related to the creation of the product in question will not be carried out without your consent.

You are responsible for checking the proof for accuracy and completeness and notifying us of any errors. We accept no liability for unreported errors.

  • You are responsible for checking the proof for accuracy and completeness and notifying us of any errors. We accept no liability for unreported errors.
The prices quoted in the respective offers are net prices. They do not include statutory VAT.

Shipping costs are not included in the purchase price; they will be shown separately unless free shipping is guaranteed. Further information can be found on our website by clicking the relevant button or in the respective offer.

For deliveries to countries outside the European Union, we may incur unreasonable additional costs, such as customs duties, taxes or money transfer fees (transfer or foreign exchange fees charged by banks), which you will have to bear.

You must also bear the costs of money transfers if the delivery is made to an EU member state, but the payment is initiated outside the European Union.

Payment options are displayed via a corresponding button on our website or in the respective offer. Unless a different payment term is specified on the invoice or for individual payment methods, payment is due immediately upon conclusion of the contract. A discount is only permissible if it is expressly stated in the respective offer or on the invoice.

  • Delivery conditions
The estimated delivery date is stated in the respective offer. Delivery dates and conditions are only binding if confirmed by us in writing. In the case of advance payment by bank transfer, the goods will only be shipped after receipt of the full purchase price and shipping costs.

Should a product you ordered be unavailable despite timely processing of the transaction, for reasons beyond our control, you will be informed immediately. In the event of a cancellation, any payments already made will be refunded to you promptly.

Shipping is at your own risk. Upon request, the goods can be shipped with suitable transport insurance; you will bear the resulting costs.

Partial deliveries are permitted and can be arranged independently by you, provided that you do not incur any additional shipping costs as a result.
  • Guarantee
The warranty period is one year from delivery of the goods. A reduction of this period is not possible.

- for damages that are attributable to our fault and that arise from injuries to life, body or health as well as from other damages due to intent or gross negligence;

- insofar as we have fraudulently concealed the defect or have assumed a warranty for the quality of the goods;

- for goods that were used in accordance with their instructions for use in a building and whose defects were caused by this;

- for statutory recourse claims that you may have against us in connection with warranty rights.

Regarding the quality of the goods, only our own information and the manufacturer's product description are considered agreed upon, not other advertising, public sales promotion measures or statements by the manufacturer.

In the event of defects, we will, at our discretion, provide a warranty by repair or replacement. Should the defect not be remedied, you may, at your option, demand a price reduction or withdraw from the contract. Remedying the defect is considered complete after a second unsuccessful repair attempt, unless circumstances preclude this, particularly due to the nature of the item and/or the defect or other conditions. In the case of repair, we will not bear any additional costs incurred by transporting the item to a location other than the place of performance, unless such transport is in accordance with the intended use of the item.

  • Right of retention, reservation of title
The right of retention can only be exercised if it concerns claims arising from the same contractual relationship.

The goods remain our property until all claims arising from the ongoing business relationship have been settled in full. Pledging or assigning the goods as security before ownership has passed is not permitted.

You may resell the goods in the ordinary course of business. For this purpose, you hereby assign to us all claims arising from the resale up to the amount of the invoice; we accept this assignment. You are authorized to collect the receivables. Should you fail to meet your payment obligations, we reserve the right to collect the receivables ourselves.

In the case of combining and mixing goods that are subject to retention of title, we acquire co-ownership in proportion to the invoice value of the goods to the other processed items at the time of processing.

We are obligated to release securities to which you are entitled as soon as the economic value of our securities exceeds the secured claims by more than 10%. The selection of the securities to be released is at our discretion.

  • Choice of law, place of performance, place of jurisdiction
German law applies, excluding the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods.

The place of performance and jurisdiction is our company headquarters, provided you are a representative, a legal entity under public law, or a special fund under public law. The same applies if you do not have a general place of jurisdiction in Germany or the EU.
